_note: Player-facing UI strings for Gamie's overnight steps (party panel, combat, inventory, title/saves). Greek: story/el/ui_text.el.json, same keys. Button labels aim for <=8 chars; where one language runs over, a sibling '<key>_short' exists in both files. Placeholders: {hero} {target} {monster} {item} {n} {max} {date}; names come from story/names.json. Combat/inventory log lines live in log.json. Reuse, don't duplicate: title_text.json (title buttons, slots, overwrite, saved, save_blocked, areas, language), log.json (hit, miss, monster_hit, out_of_reach, not_ready, hero_down, party_dead, drink_potion, chest_open, chest_empty, pickup_*, oil_pickup, torch_*), barks.json (tut_*).

step1_party_panel._about: Party panel, hand buttons, bars, Wren's oil gauge, wall-torch choice.

torch_choice.snuff_hint: Put it out. Relight costs 1 oil.
torch_choice.hands_full: No free hand. Tap a hand to swap.

hands._about: Action name shown on/under a hand button, by gear id (art/ui/hands/hands.json).

sheet.swap_hint: Drag a face to swap places.

step2_combat._about: Combat floaters and short labels. Log lines are in log.json (see STORY_HOOKUP.md).

game_over.title: The water takes you all.
game_over.body: The keep keeps you. For now.

step3_inventory._about: Bag UI, item names and descriptions. name = full name, short = <=8 for slots/buttons, desc = flavour, effect = rules line.

potion_green.name: Green potion
potion_green.effect: Pulls off leeches, cures poison, +5 HP.

oil_flask.name: Oil flask
oil_flask.desc: Dwarves kept it like other folk keep wine.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Hot end out. Hot end OUT, Brannoc.
torch.effect: Swings for fire damage. Fits an empty bracket.

captain_key.name: Captain's key
captain_key.effect: Opens the cell wing. Then a keepsake.

iron_shield.name: Iron shield
iron_shield.effect: Block: +3 AC, next hit on you halved. Mags or Ilsevar.

chain_mail.name: Chain mail
chain_mail.desc: Sixty years in a damp barracks. Itchy.
chain_mail.effect: +2 AC. Ilsevar can't cast in it.

ashmantle_hammer.name: Ashmantle hammer
ashmantle_hammer.desc: Two hammers, lass. This is one of them.
ashmantle_hammer.effect: Brannoc only. Hits hard, swings slow.

axe.name: Axe
axe.desc: Brannoc's. Older than Mags, and sharper.

shield.name: Dwarven shield
shield.desc: Oak and iron. Hides a whole dwarf.
shield.effect: Block: +4 AC, next hit on anyone halved.

mace.name: Mace
mace.desc: For the Ember's more direct sermons.

prayer_lantern.name: Prayer lantern
prayer_lantern.desc: Wren's. The last fire she trusts.
prayer_lantern.effect: Heals the most hurt hero 6-10. 4 mana.

wand.name: Reed wand
wand.desc: Swamp reed and patience. Mostly patience.
wand.effect: Ranged. Works from the back row.

scroll.name: Frost scroll
scroll.desc: Cold words. Ilsevar reads them slowly.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.desc: Mags's. Don't ask where it's been.

tricks_pouch.name: Tricks pouch
tricks_pouch.desc: Sand, string and one mystery button.
tricks_pouch.effect: Pocket sand: next attack misses. Picks locks.

journal.title: Journal
